ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

17. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

21. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Hand washing PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the teeth PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitation/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Foods/Feeding PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
